hook.name: HyperTaxHook
hook.description: Singleton hook that collects a fixed per-pool tax (0–5%) on every swap. After each swap it takes its share of the unspecified output side: if ETH, sends it directly to the registered launcher address; if token, sells the tokens back into the same pool via a nested swap and forwards the ETH proceeds. Only the factory can register pools or initialize them; no owner or upgrade mechanism exists.
